# clerk_instance_domain (Resource)

Manages a domain on a Clerk instance via the Instance API (Clerk Go SDK). For managing domains via the Platform API, use clerk_domain instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "clerk_instance_domain" "example" {
  name = "app.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The domain name (e.g. app.example.com).

### Optional

- `is_satellite` (Boolean) Whether this is a satellite domain. Create-only; changing forces replacement.
- `proxy_url` (String) The proxy URL for the domain.

### Read-Only

- `accounts_portal_url` (String) The accounts portal URL for this domain.
- `frontend_api_url` (String) The frontend API URL for this domain.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the domain.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import clerk_instance_domain.example <instance_domain_id>
```
